h: East London Extras for a Full Day Out
p: Planning a group trip? Get your activities booked ahead, and agree on a rough plan for the day so nobody ends up stuck waiting while others play. Multi-activity venues work best when you pick a few highlights rather than trying to do absolutely everything in one go. Bring a bit of patience for busy weekends and school holidays, when the whole area can be heaving.

Stratford has changed beyond recognition since the 2012 Olympics, and there's loads to see around the venue. Lee Valley VeloPark is home to the velodrome used in the Games, and you can often try cycling on the BMX track or road circuit. The Copper Box Arena hosts sports and events, and the London Aquatics Centre is open for public swimming, giving you the chance to splash in an Olympic pool.

For something different, wander west to Hackney Wick, where canals, street art and creative studios give the area a real buzz. Three Mills Island, along the River Lea, is a peaceful spot with historic mill buildings, a contrast to the shiny new developments nearby.

Music fans might want to look into ABBA Voyage, the hit virtual concert at the ABBA Arena near Pudding Mill Lane station, a short hop from Stratford. Tickets need booking well in advance, but it's a memorable night out if you can make it work.
